title: Data Science / AI ML Engineer
jobDescription:
About the Role: We are hiring Data Science / AI & ML Engineers (Freshers) to work on compiler frameworks, transformer-based infrastructures, and end-to-end AI pipelines. You will collaborate with research teams to translate mathematical models into optimized execution graphs, implement custom kernels and low-level performance optimizations, and contribute to the development of deep learning frameworks and execution runtimes powering large-scale model training.
Education: Any Graduate
Key Responsibilities: Design and develop compiler frameworks that optimize AI model execution at the kernel, graph, and operator levels; Architect scalable transformer-based infrastructures for distributed multi-node training and efficient inference; Build end-to-end AI pipelines including graph optimizations, memory scheduling, and compute distribution; Collaborate with research teams to translate mathematical models into optimized execution graphs and intermediate representations (IRs); Implement custom kernels, quantization strategies, and low-level performance optimizations in C/C++ and CUDA; Analyze and tune runtime performance bottlenecks focusing on parallelization, vectorization, and memory management; Develop domain-specific compiler passes for tensor operations, automatic differentiation, and operator fusion; Conduct systematic experiments to explore scaling laws, precision formats, and architectural optimizations for improved computational efficiency; Contribute to the development and optimization of deep learning frameworks and execution runtimes, focusing on tensor computation graphs, distributed training pipelines, and execution scheduling; Work on data and training infrastructure including dataset preparation pipelines, tokenization strategies, preprocessing workflows, and evaluation systems for large-scale model training; Participate in model efficiency research including quantization techniques, sparsity methods, precision formats, and inference optimization for large-scale neural networks
Requirements: Strong proficiency in C, C++ or Java, with good command over pointers, memory management, performance optimization, and systems-level programming; Solid foundation in Mathematics - calculus, probability, statistics, and linear algebra; Strong logical reasoning, problem-solving ability, high intelligence (IQ), and an analytical mindset; Ability to operate effectively in a research-driven, high-intensity environment with cross-functional collaboration

Requirements: Strong communication, articulation, and relationship-building skills; Intellectual curiosity about artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and global tech ecosystems; Ability to connect business challenges with advanced technology solutions; Confidence engaging with enterprise leaders, research communities, and industry networks; Ownership mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and drive initiatives independently

title: Social Media Growth Manager (AI / Deep Tech)
experienceRequired: 1-6 Years / Proven Social Media Growth Experience
jobDescription:
About the Role: This role sits at the intersection of social media growth, creator-led marketing, deep-tech communication, brand positioning, and digital distribution. You will work closely with leadership, research, engineering, hiring, and business teams to understand BluBridge's deep-tech products, research work, company direction, hiring campaigns, and founder communication — and convert those inputs into strong social media campaigns across LinkedIn, X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, Medium, and other relevant platforms. Mandatory requirement: the candidate must satisfy at least one platform benchmark — X/Twitter: 500+ followers, YouTube: 10,000+ subscribers, Instagram: 25,000+ followers, or LinkedIn: 5,000+ followers.
Education: Graduation Not Required
Key Responsibilities: Plan and execute social media campaigns for BluBridge's deep-tech products, research work, hiring initiatives, founder communication, company milestones, and business initiatives; Build platform-specific strategies for LinkedIn, X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, Medium, and other relevant channels; Use proven social media growth experience to improve reach, engagement, visibility, follower quality, and brand recall; Create campaigns that are strategically useful for brand building, hiring, business development, ecosystem visibility, and company positioning; Convert BluBridge's deep learning products/systems, research outputs, AI systems, infrastructure work, and hiring campaigns into public-facing social media content; Develop content formats such as LinkedIn posts, X/Twitter threads, Instagram reels, YouTube shorts and long-form concepts, founder posts, product explainers, research announcement posts, hiring campaign content, carousel content, and short video scripts; Help position BluBridge as a serious AI research and engineering company with a sharp, credible, intelligent, and globally relevant voice across all platforms; Take ownership of BluBridge's social media growth including content planning, creation direction, posting discipline, engagement strategy, audience development, analytics tracking, campaign reporting, and competitor observation; Coordinate with designers, video editors, photographers, leadership, and internal teams to execute high-quality content; Provide clear creative direction for reels, shorts, thumbnails, carousels, posters, research visuals, founder clips, hiring creatives, event coverage, YouTube formats, and campaign assets
Requirements: Must satisfy at least one platform benchmark: X/Twitter 500+ followers, YouTube 10,000+ subscribers, Instagram 25,000+ followers, or LinkedIn 5,000+ followers; Proven social media growth experience with an existing personal or managed audience base; Strong understanding of platform algorithms and audience behavior; Ability to create content that gets reach and builds trust; Strong writing, articulation, and content judgment; Ability to understand deep-tech products and convert them into campaigns; Strong ownership mindset with good sense of branding, hooks, positioning, and digital storytelling; Ability to show proof of social media growth, reach, engagement, or campaign performance
